Option B fits best. Typing a new tag and pressing Enter is simple, while seeing and clicking existing tags will help me avoid accidentally creating slightly different versions of the same tag.

The `#` chips look good. I’d expect clicking one on a saved bookmark to show me everything with that tag. The highlighted note is clear for a short note, but I may write longer notes and use simple formatting such as links, bold text, or lists, so I’d want that formatting to display properly rather than showing the raw symbols.
